title.zh: GPT-6.1 Terra发布：电脑操作测试追平Astra，Token单价只有十分之一
title.en: GPT-6.1 Terra发布：电脑操作测试追平Astra，Token单价只有十分之一

current_state.zh: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper and faster computer-use model that matches flagship GPT-6 Astra on the Agents' Last Exam professional-task benchmark at one-tenth the token price, with API rates of $1/$5 per million input/output tokens and availability on ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
